title: Hardcore LAN Commands
description: Allows enabling commands/cheats when opening a hardcore world to LAN, reverting the 26.2+ changes!
body:
# Hardcore LAN Commands

Starting from Minecraft Version `26.2-pre-5`, players can no longer enable commands/cheats when opening a hardcore world to LAN.

Hardcore LAN Commands reverts these changes, allowing players to enable commands/cheats for themselves and others.

## Installation

Hardcore LAN Commands is a client-side mod. It only needs to be installed by the player hosting the singleplayer/LAN world.

This mod does not affect dedicated servers, Realms, or worlds hosted by other players.
